description.value:
You are a master of grappling and unarmed combat. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 damage instead of the normal 1, and you can choose to deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with them.

You have advantage on checks made to grapple a creature, and once per turn when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can attempt to shove that creature 5 feet away or knock it prone as part of the same attack, with no additional action required.
